sources.title: Self-build and custom housebuilding
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Authorities must maintain registers and have regard to them; Part 1 demand informs the duty to permission sufficient serviced plots, not specific named parcels.

sources.title: Data release: Self-build and custom housebuilding data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: National management information reports register entries and permissions for serviced plots; aggregate counts are not candidate-specific demand or delivery evidence.

sources.title: Self-build and custom housebuilding data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The official collection documents local-authority monitoring of right-to-build registers; dataset presence does not identify a sample parcel as a serviced plot.

sources.title: Registers - Local Self-build Register
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states registration helps assess demand but does not guarantee a suitable plot will be identified or become available.

sources.title: Self build register
sources.verified_claim: Havering separates Part 1 baseline demand from Part 2 general demand and states Part 1 demand must be met through sufficient permissions within the statutory period.

sources.title: Register your interest for self-build or custom housebuilding
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explicitly states registration does not guarantee a suitable plot and uses the register to understand demand across planning, housing, land-disposal and regeneration functions.

sources.title: Housing and Planning Act 2016 - self-build and custom housebuilding notes
sources.verified_claim: The 2016 Act supplements the 2015 duties on local authorities to keep and have regard to registers of people seeking land for self-build and custom housebuilding.

sources.title: Independent review into scaling up self-build and custom housebuilding: recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The review notes register demand can be incomplete and should not be treated as a complete measure of underlying demand, preserving a conservative candidate interpretation.
